questions.question:
Which of the following sequences of signs would replace '*' to correctly solve the given equation?

14 * 24 * 3 * 5 * 3 * 7
questions.solution:
1) +, ÷, -, ×, =

Given expression: 14 * 24 * 3 * 5 * 3 * 7

After replacing the *’s by the signs given on the option above, we get:

14 + 24 ÷ 3 - 5 × 3 = 7

=> 14 + 8 – 15 = 7

=> 22 – 15 = 7

=> 7 = 7

2) +, ÷, ×, -, =

Given expression: 14 * 24 * 3 * 5 * 3 * 7

After replacing the *’s by the signs given on the option above, we get:

14 + 24 ÷ 3 × 5 - 3 = 7

=> 14 + 8 × 5 – 3 = 7

=> 14 + 40 – 3 = 7

=> 54 – 3 = 7

=> 51 ≠ 7

3) ÷, +, ×, -, =

Given expression: 14 * 24 * 3 * 5 * 3 * 7

After replacing the *’s by the signs given on the option above, we get:

14 ÷ 24 + 3 × 5 - 3 = 7

=> 0.58 + 15 – 3 = 7

=> 15.58 – 3 = 7

=> 12.58 ≠ 7

4) +, ×, ÷, -, =

Given expression: 14 * 24 * 3 * 5 * 3 * 7

After replacing the *’s by the signs given on the option above, we get:

14 + 24 × 3 ÷ 5 - 3 = 7

=> 14 + 14.4 – 3 = 7

=> 28.4 – 3 = 7

=> 25.5 ≠ 7

Hence, ‘**+, ÷, -, ×, =**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: The Himalayas consist of ______ main parallel ranges.
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Himalaya is the **youngest fold mountain **range in the world.
 
• The word Himalaya means "**the abode of snow**".
 
• The Himalaya is mostly formed of sedimentary rocks.
 
• The Himalayas consist of **three**__ main parallel ranges, namely:
 
 
• The greater Himalayas.
 
• The lesser Himalayas.
 
• The outer Himalayas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The northernmost range of the Himalaya is known as the **Great Himalayas.**

 
 
• It is also called Himadri.
 
• Himadri is the backbone of the Himalaya.
 
• It is the most continuous range consisting of the loftiest peaks with an average height of 6,000 metres.
 
• It contains all the prominent Himalayan peaks like Mount Everest, Annapoorna, Nandadevi, etc.
 
 
 
• The **Lesser Himalayas **is the mountain range that lies between Himadri and Siwalik.
 
 
• It is also called Himachal.
 
• It is mainly composed of highly compressed and altered rocks.
 
• The altitude varies between 3,700 and 4,500 metres and the average width is 50 Km.
 
• Pir Panjal is the largest range in Himachal.
 
• This region is well known for its hill stations.
 
 
 
• The outermost range of the Himalayas is called the **Shiwalik**(Outer Himalayas.)
 
 
• It extends over a width of 10-50 Km and has an altitude varying between 900 and 1100 metres.
 
• The word Shiwalik literally means "tresses of Shiva".
 
• Shiwalik is parallel to the Ganga plain.

questions.question: -40 degrees Fahrenheit is equal to how many degrees on the Celsius scale?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**– 40.**__

 __
